text:
maria r.: FYI Cascade Systems hit a blocker on their private deploy in ap-southeast-1. customer sees pod crashes during agent init. they want an architecture quick-check and escalation before their Fri go-live. @ajay @samir can you jump in?
ajay patel: On it. What do the pod logs show? any image signing errors or kernel/module failures?
maria r.: Root logs: agent fails mounting /dev/kvm and blows up on loading redwood-net-bridge module. brief excerpt: 
```
ERROR: module redwood-net-bridge: init failed - unknown symbol: register_netdevice
W: iptables-nft vs legacy mismatch reported
```
Also their infra team mentions custom NIC firmware (Mellanox fork) and they are using an older distro (Ubuntu 18.04).
heather liu: ugh older distro + custom NICs can surface odd kernel symbol mismatches. for inference runtime we rely on vfio/vhost features but this sounds lower-level. is TLS termination at the load balancer or on the node for their private deploy?
maria r.: TLS terminated at LB. this fails earlier, during node init. customer reported they tried to load our signed kernel module but kernel rejects signature (they're on custom secureboot policy).
samir khan: timeline? Cascade says go-live Fri EOD; they're blocked on this before we can finish the SI checklist. marketplace image signing window is tomorrow AM — we may need to delay or provide a staged workaround.
lucas (oncall-bot): incident created: INC-243001 — "cascade private deploy: module load failure". assigned to eng-oncall. pagerduty: @eng-oncall.
ajay patel: ok plan: 1) get kernel log and dmesg from failed node; 2) request network capture during module load if possible; 3) suggest a workaround to run without the kernel module (host-network fallback) while we triage. can someone paste helm values snippet for the fallback?
maria r.: trying fallback now — quick helm patch we used in staging: 
```yaml
agent:
  kmodEnabled: false
  hostNetwork: true
  tolerations: []
```
I'll apply to a single canary node and run smoke.
deploy-bot: marketplace:+1 image-sign-check started for redwood/cascade-agent:2026.03. HEAD sha: abc1234.
ajay patel: if fallback works, that'll buy time. but we still need signed-module path for long term. ask Cascade infra for kernel version + `modinfo redwood-net-bridge` output and whether they enforce secureboot keys. also we should collect `uname -a` and `cat /sys/module/redwood_net_bridge/parameters/*` if present.
samir khan: i have Cascade infra contact: Jenna Ortiz (jenna.ortiz@cascade.io). i'll DM and set up a 30m handoff call in 20m. i'll invite @ajay @maria and their infra lead.
maria r.: thanks. i'll post results of canary run here in ~15m. if hostNetwork smoke passes we'll request a temporary exception to go-live and follow up with on-prem module signing doc. :thumbsup:
heather liu: also adding note for postmortem: add distro coverage matrix for the kmod and update onboarding checklist for secureboot workflows.
maria r.: agreed. updating the SI checklist item now. will circle back.
